review.use_summary: Screened DCM, NICM, HCM and eight left-ventricular MRI GWASs for genetic correlation. Selected Ecc and indexed LV end-systolic volume from two clusters with positive rg>0.7, then combined them with DCM in a three-trait MTAG 1.0.8 run using default parameters. Reported maxFDR 0.03 and an approximately 73% effective-sample-size increase for DCM.
review.implementation_scope_note: Scoped original MTAG1.0.8 common-SNP workflows with explicit two-to-eight-trait inputs, native effect/tail/identity/diagnostic audits and complete saved verification are available through mtag-tools; read MTAG_INTEGRATION.md. This tested source commit does not establish the paper historical commit or reconstruct its unreported settings. The final run combines DCM, Ecc and LVESVi; the initial correlation screen is a different stage. The selection is positive rg>0.7, not an absolute-correlation rule. The authors separate JATS equation provides n_snp_eff=1/(2*MAF*(1-MAF)*SE^2), recorded in mtag-P088-equation-source-review.json; it is not attributed to the adjacent paragraph text. Supply explicitly prepared Z/N and preserve author units. The original source beta/SE input mode is disabled; no replacement input mode or effective-N definition is inferred.

review.use_summary: Compared six selections of MDD-related GWAS inputs to create integrated LifetimeMDD statistics. Repeated GWAS and MTAG within each 90% training fold before separate PRSice scoring of held-out participants. Used MTAG-derived effective N downstream in LDSC, and reported input-sensitive findings and heritability inflation.
review.implementation_scope_note: Scoped original MTAG1.0.8 common-SNP workflows with explicit two-to-eight-trait inputs, native effect/tail/identity/diagnostic audits and complete saved verification are available through mtag-tools; read MTAG_INTEGRATION.md. This tested source commit does not establish the paper historical commit or reconstruct its unreported settings. Six input selections and fold-specific90% training analyses are separate requests; no automatic inclusion of217 phenotypes or reuse of held-out data is authorized by this description. The authors report input-sensitive results and heritability inflation. The full six sets require the figure/supplement. MTAG version/complete commands are unstated. The paper explicitly uses MTAG-derived effective N downstream in LDSC; distinguish it from per-SNP, case/control and imputation effective Ns, then choose and label the intended downstream value.
